ticket.title: Add the recording sink and a self-describing capture format
ticket.description: ROADMAP M3 requires a recorded capture to replay to identical JSON on two machines, and M4 requires end-to-end tests on recorded datasets, but nothing records a feed today. ADR-0009 fixes the seam: a RecordSink in a std-only aerofoil-persistence crate, with JSONL as implementation zero and no dependency beyond serde_json. The format has to be self-describing because the normal deployment is two bands from two dongles, so a recording must carry band, source and arrival time or a replay cannot reproduce what the tracker saw. The sink is a bounded drop-oldest subscriber with its own counters: recording must never backpressure the decoder.
acceptance_criteria: RecordSink trait in aerofoil-persistence with bounded drop-oldest subscriber and drop counters
Self-describing RecordedFrame with band, source, timestamp, and raw payload
Deterministic JSONL sink and replay iterator reproducing identical capture feeds
All source files strictly under 200 lines adhering to 250-line ceiling
